name: Database user password
description: A database user's password for SCRAM-SHA authentication to a database in an Atlas cluster, chosen by whoever creates the user.

blockers.summary: The password is caller-chosen; the only documented structure is a minimum length of 8 and an 'alphanumeric' description.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
